spindle.observe.UnmetInput.title: UnmetInput
spindle.observe.UnmetInput.description: One event binding whose command input the event did not fill: a required field absent, or a value carried across a declared conversion that is no value of the input's type. The command is not invoked: zero attempts, no retry, and the event's other bindings still run; the command that published the event stays committed. ESS 0.90.0 calls this an unmet binding-input obligation, with no attempt and no policy, only for a binding whose failure policy is chosen per refusal, answers the same failure of every other binding unsupported, and defines no observable result for either (`crates/verify/ess-conformance/src/interpret/bindings.rs`). The rule for every binding and this answer are Spindle's (`docs/design/spindle.md` § 11, unmet binding input; `spindle_channel::Unmet`).

component.description: The component that accepts the command.

command.description: The qualified name of the command not invoked.

reason.description: Why the input could not be filled, as the runtime words it, bounded as a record's `reason` is: its words and the names it gives (the binding, the input, a type) kept, a value the event carried never recorded: every value in the text (a quoted string, a list, an object, a number, `true`, `false` or `null`) is written `…`. At most 512 bytes, cut with `…` where longer.
